notes.title: Update 1.1.0
notes.notes:
Hello Guardians,

With Update 1.1.0 we are revising the ui and increasing the number of total levels to play.

PATCH NOTES

[list]
[*]Added 10 more levels
[*]New look for level selection buttons
[*]Added repeatability of the tutorial
[/list]
